key_idea: Follow the arrows from In to Out and write down each sticker as Sam passes it.
steps: On floor 1 Sam starts at In and passes the red triangle first. The wall stops her, so she takes the stairs up.
On floor 2 she passes the blue circle, then the green square.
She comes down to the other side of floor 1 and passes the yellow diamond on the way to Out.
The order is triangle, circle, square, diamond.

choice_feedback.A: Sam passes the triangle before she goes up to the circle.
choice_feedback.B: On floor 2 the circle comes before the square.
choice_feedback.C: The diamond is on floor 1, after Sam comes back down. The square comes before it.
choice_feedback.E: The triangle comes first, near In.
